requirements.evidence: routes/api.php:8-20 registers the four endpoints with the 10/min and 30/min throttles; TotemAuthController.php:29-39,73-87 validates the code format, locks/consumes the preset atomically, creates the totem and issues the JWT with the entity pair; AuthenticateTotem.php:34-47,58-62,75-77 covers every 401 case and intersects the queue claim with the preset join; TotemQueueController.php:19-46,48-74,76-117 returns the documented payloads and 403/404/422 codes; migrations match the data model (create_totem_presets_table.php:15-23, create_totem_preset_queue_table.php:15-21); PairingCodeCommand.php:11,27-48 generates/prints the code and fails on unknown ids; .env.example:82-85, phpunit.xml:45-47, config/services.php:43-46; docs/api/totem.md:15,205-239,338-361 plus database-schema/architecture updates.

conventions.evidence: Reversible down() in every migration (create_totems_table.php:27); deliberate #[Fillable] (Totem.php:11, TotemPreset.php:12); IssueTicket reused (TotemQueueController.php:101); Pest tests for every endpoint/command (TotemApiTest.php); docs kept in sync. Deviations: the pairing domain write stays in the controller (TotemAuthController.php:35-87) instead of an app/Actions class, and there is no CHANGELOG.md entry.

security.evidence: HS256 with an alg check and hash_equals (TotemJwt.php:52-58), exp/iat validation (:68-72), fail-closed secret (:95-105); middleware rejects every invalid state and scopes queues to the preset (AuthenticateTotem.php:34-77); queue lookup is confined to the token entity with 404/403 (TotemQueueController.php:143-154); strict CORS allowlist with no credentials (TotemCors.php:35-62); audit entries never include the code (TotemAuthController.php:116-132); route throttles (routes/api.php:9,20).

tests.evidence: TotemApiTest.php:26-68 code format/failure paths, :93-103 pairing throttle, :105-145 token failure matrix, :147-190 queue listing and scope intersection, :192-221 priorities, :223-277 issuance/invalid priority/inactive queue, :279-294 cross-entity leakage, :296-311 CORS, :313-345 command and relation. simplicity.evidence: Reuses IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:101) and a single TicketPriority enum (app/Enums/TicketPriority.php:11-65); compact JWT (TotemJwt.php:18-127). Minor duplication: preset queue pluck in TotemAuthController.php:82-85 and AuthenticateTotem.php:70-73; the inactive-queue check repeats in TotemQueueController.php:62-64 and :90-92; appearance overrides (TotemPresentation.php:28-46) go slightly beyond the minimum.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (TotemQueueController.php:19-46, 48-74, 76-117), clear names, ordered imports, no dead code or debugging output; context() is documented (TotemQueueController.php:123-133).

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the totem task: routes/api.php, controllers, middleware, models, migrations, factories, config/services.php, .env.example, phpunit.xml, bootstrap/app.php, tests, and the three required docs (docs/api/totem.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md); no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: Pairing is a domain write (consume the code, create the totem, issue the token) implemented in the controller, while the project convention routes domain writes through an app/Actions/* use-case class such as IssueTicket.
The change is not recorded under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md, which the conventions require for every change.
Only the 10/min pairing throttle is tested; there is no test that POST /api/{entity}/{queue}/ticket returns 429 {"code":"rate_limited"} after 30 requests per minute.
No test asserts that pairing success and failure write an audit entry and that the full code is never logged, although that is an explicit task requirement.
fromRequest() also accepts numeric strings such as '010' and '-0'; the contract declares an <int> and the whitelist would be stricter if only integers were accepted.

Log::channel('audit')?->info(...) uses a nullsafe operator on a non-null LoggerInterface; Log::channel() throws when the channel is not defined, so the ?-> is misleading (same pattern at TotemAuthController.php:116,126).

The pairing-command test does not assert that the regenerated code differs from the previous one or that the old code stops working, so the 'regenerating replaces the previous code' rule is not directly verified.

review.summary: Implements the totem BFF end to end: migrations, models, factories, the pairing command, the JWT auth endpoint and middleware, the three queue endpoints with scope intersection, CORS, config, docs and a broad Pest suite. Requirements and security are met; the remaining comments are minor (pairing write not in an Action, missing CHANGELOG entry, and a few untested paths), so the change is approvable with nits. Confidence is medium because IssueTicket's signature and the audit log channel are outside the diff.
